name: Aihara Aiko
source:
Aiko is a sergeant of the Moon Demon Company and the leader of a fifteen-man squad. Brave, selfless, and compassionate, Aiko is a serious and hardworking soldier who cares deeply about her comrades. She cares about them so deeply to the point where she is ready to sacrifice herself for them.

[From [url=http://owarinoseraph.wikia.com/wiki/Aiko_Aihara]Owari no Seraph Wiki[/url]]
